per_book.name: ki

per_book.name: ten
per_book.gloss: the turn — recontextualisation; the promise contract falls due here

per_book.name: ketsu
per_book.gloss: reconciliation — the elements re-seen together; closure is a choice

age.note: age claims are kept as age with interval and compared directly — an age-to-birth-year conversion is never applied to a recorded drift; c3-08 replays as the two recorded ages

interval.to: <book>.<last chapter of the beat> or null for scope end

checklist: is the ten a recontextualisation, not an escalation borrowed from a conflict spine
is the promise contract named and spent at the ten
is closure at the ketsu a recorded choice (open endings carry a stated market risk)
is withholding doing the work conflict would otherwise do
does any Western conflict layer appear only where the decision record allows it

collisions_whitelisted.rule: flag only when used as a beat name (heading, beat sheet or structural entry), never in running prose

pick_a_side_points.question: what promise falls due at the ten of this book, and where was it planted
does the ketsu close or stay open — an open ending is a choice with a stated market risk
does this book carry any conflict spine, or does withholding do the work — recorded per book in the decision record
